avoid_supplements.name: Metoclopramide
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Metoclopramide is a dopamine antagonist that directly opposes cabergoline's mechanism of action, reducing therapeutic efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; use alternative antiemetics (ondansetron, prochlorperazine at lowest dose) if needed

avoid_supplements.name: Strong CYP3A4 inhibitors (e.g., ketoconazole, itraconazole, ritonavir)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Inhibition of CYP3A4 increases cabergoline plasma levels and prolongs exposure, increasing risk of adverse effects (hypotension, valvular disease)
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid or use with caution; monitor blood pressure and consider dose reduction if co-administration necessary

avoid_supplements.name: Ergot alkaloids (bromocriptine, pergolide, methysergide)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Additive dopaminergic effects and potential for combined ergotism, increasing risk of vasospasm and cardiac valvulopathy
avoid_supplements.action: Contraindicated; do not combine with other ergot derivatives

caution_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
caution_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inducer that may reduce cabergoline plasma concentrations and therapeutic effect
caution_supplements.action: Advise patient to inform prescriber; monitor for reduced efficacy and consider dose adjustment

caution_supplements.name: Ginseng
caution_supplements.mechanism: May potentiate dopaminergic effects, increasing risk of hypotension or CNS stimulation
caution_supplements.action: Use with caution; monitor blood pressure and counsel on potential additive effects

caution_supplements.name: High-dose Vitamin B6 (>100 mg/day)
caution_supplements.mechanism: Vitamin B6 is a cofactor for dopamine synthesis and may potentiate dopaminergic activity
caution_supplements.action: Limit supplemental B6 to RDA levels (1.3-1.7 mg/day); monitor for excessive dopaminergic effects

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit and grapefruit juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: Potent CYP3A4 inhibitor that significantly increases cabergoline bioavailability and plasma levels, elevating risk of hypotension and adverse effects
avoid_foods.action: Completely avoid grapefruit and grapefruit juice during cabergoline therapy

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May delay gastric emptying and slightly increase cabergoline absorption, potentially affecting peak serum levels
caution_foods.action: Administer cabergoline consistently with or without food; maintain consistent dietary pattern for optimal therapeutic control

caution_foods.name: Tyramine-rich foods (aged cheeses, cured meats, fermented foods)
caution_foods.mechanism: Dopamine agonists may have minor effects on norepinephrine metabolism; excessive tyramine intake could theoretically elevate blood pressure
caution_foods.action: No strict restriction required, but counsel on moderation; monitor blood pressure if consuming large amounts

monitoring_notes: Monitor blood pressure regularly, especially at treatment initiation or dose escalation, and assess for signs of cardiac valvulopathy (dyspnea, edema, new cardiac murmurs). Baseline and periodic echocardiography recommended, particularly with long-term use; counsel patient to avoid grapefruit products and ergot-containing medications absolutely.
